headline: You can watch the coolant flow inside Ugreen’s liquid-cooled power bank
summary: Ugreen launched its new MagFlow Pro Magnetic Power Bank. It features visible liquid-cooling technology and a 'Cyber Window'. Priced at $149.99 for 10,000mAh, it's a high-end power bank option.

headline: Dungeons & Dragons is getting a ‘Ravenloft’ live-action Netflix series
summary: A live-action Dungeons & Dragons 'Ravenloft' series is in development for Netflix. Alfonso Cuarón and John August are involved as executive producers. It will bring to life one of D&D's iconic gothic-horror campaign settings.

headline: Congressman says TikTok backed out of a meeting to avoid child safety questions
summary: TikTok reportedly canceled a congressional committee meeting this month. The committee chair claims TikTok avoided questions on child safety practices. The meeting aimed to address concerns about Chinese government access to data.

headline: Samsung’s beloved Q Series sound system is hundreds off for Labor Day
summary: Samsung's Q990F Soundbar is available for $999.99 at Best Buy and Amazon. This represents a significant discount from its usual $1,300-$1,600 retail price. It's a rare deal on a highly-rated sound system.

headline: Netflix Is Making a Live-Action Dungeons & Dragons Series About Darklord Strahd Von Zarovich's Origin Story
summary: Netflix is developing a live-action D&D TV series based on the Ravenloft campaign. The show will specifically explore the origin story of the vampire villain, Darklord Strahd von Zarovich. It adapts the tabletop RPG's gothic-horror setting.

headline: Blizzard Might Be Teasing A New StarCraft Game
summary: The official StarCraft website is displaying unusual glitches and flickering elements. This has led to speculation that Blizzard is teasing a new StarCraft game. The current site still features content for StarCraft Remastered.

headline: Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves Directors Say Film Flopped Due to 'Not-So-Great' Timing
summary: Directors attribute 'Honor Among Thieves' box office flop to unfortunate timing. They cited competition from 'The Super Mario Bros. Movie' as a factor. Drama surrounding D&D licensing changes also contributed to its struggles.

headline: Miami-Dade Sheriff and Commissioner Slam City's Proposed GTA 6 Takeover for 'Promoting Fictional Version of Our Community Defined by Crime and Violence'
summary: Miami-Dade Sheriff opposes the city's plan to celebrate the GTA 6 launch with widespread advertisements. The Sheriff argues it glorifies crime and undermines law enforcement efforts. Critics believe the game promotes a violent image of the community.

headline: Farage senior aide filmed suggesting way to avoid donations law
summary: A Channel 4 film shows senior Reform UK figures discussing donations. They were filmed suggesting methods to avoid donations law with an undercover reporter. The footage raises questions about the party's funding practices.

headline: Schools to close early for A66 crash funeral amid safety concerns
summary: Schools will close early for the funeral of one of five young men killed in an A66 crash. The collision involved a police car, leading to significant community impact. Early closures are being implemented due to anticipated safety concerns during the event.

headline: Fifa accuses Uefa of 'smear campaign' against Infantino
summary: Fifa has accused Uefa of running a 'smear campaign' against its president, Gianni Infantino. The accusation stems from Infantino's scrapped plan to sell World Cup stakes to private investors. The two football governing bodies have been trading public blows.

headline: British army told to stop non-essential training exercises to save money
summary: British army units not slated for deployment have been ordered to cut non-essential training. This directive is a response to ongoing cost pressures within the Ministry of Defence. The move aims to save money across UK-based operations.
